eyebrow.zh: 将中文文章分段，先预览配图位置与画面描述，再选择后端渲染并导出图片映射。
eyebrow.en: Segment a Chinese article, preview illustration positions and briefs, then render with a selected backend and export placement metadata.

headline.zh:
先看配图计划，
再决定生成什么
headline.en:
Plan the illustrations.
Then choose what to render.

sub.zh: 将中文文章分段，先预览配图位置与画面描述，再选择后端渲染并导出图片映射。
sub.en: Segment a Chinese article, preview illustration positions and briefs, then render with a selected backend and export placement metadata.

caption.zh: 文章分段 · 配图计划

body.zh: 在渲染前查看每个配图点的描述与原因。
body.en: Review each illustration brief and reason before rendering.

body.zh: dry-run 与 mock 明确标出离线占位行为。
body.en: dry-run and mock mode explicitly mark offline placeholder behavior.

body.zh: 导出包把文件与段落、prompt、seed 关联。
body.en: The export bundle links files to paragraphs, prompts and seeds.

title.zh: 先把整篇的配图安排看清楚
title.en: Review the whole article’s illustration plan

body.zh: 一篇文章要配多张图时，除了画面风格，还要考虑每张图应该接在哪一段。段绘把分段、位置计划和共享风格提示连接起来，让作者先检查计划，再进入可能收费的渲染步骤。
body.en: A multi-image article needs both visual direction and a decision about where each image belongs. DuanHui connects segmentation, placement planning and shared style prompts so authors can review the plan before a potentially paid rendering step.

body.zh: 实际运行文章配图和封面 dry-run。示例文章分为 13 段，最多 3 个配图点，另生成一条封面计划。没有生成真实插图，也没有验证模型审美或跨图一致性。
body.en: The actual article and cover dry-runs split the sample into thirteen segments, choose up to three illustration spots and create one cover plan. They do not render real illustrations or validate model aesthetics or consistency.

alt.zh: 实际运行文章配图和封面 dry-run。示例文章分为 13 段，最多 3 个配图点，另生成一条封面计划。没有生成真实插图，也没有验证模型审美或跨图一致性。
alt.en: The actual article and cover dry-runs split the sample into thirteen segments, choose up to three illustration spots and create one cover plan. They do not render real illustrations or validate model aesthetics or consistency.

body.zh: segment.py 划分并标记段落，placement.py 校验后端返回的位置与描述，style.py 给每个 spot 加入共享前缀与 seed，image backend 渲染，export.py 输出图片、placement_map.json 和 annotated.md。cover.py 提供单张封面路径。
body.en: segment.py splits and tags paragraphs. placement.py validates returned positions and briefs; style.py adds shared preambles and seeds. The image backend renders, and export.py writes images, placement_map.json and annotated.md. cover.py implements the single-cover route.

alt.zh: segment.py 划分并标记段落，placement.py 校验后端返回的位置与描述，style.py 给每个 spot 加入共享前缀与 seed，image backend 渲染，export.py 输出图片、placement_map.json 和 annotated.md。cover.py 提供单张封面路径。
alt.en: segment.py splits and tags paragraphs. placement.py validates returned positions and briefs; style.py adds shared preambles and seeds. The image backend renders, and export.py writes images, placement_map.json and annotated.md. cover.py implements the single-cover route.

body.zh: placement_map 记录每张图的段落索引、prompt 和 seed，annotated.md 给作者定位提示。共享 seed 与前缀是一种控制输入的方式，不能单独保证不同模型输出同一视觉风格。
body.en: placement_map records paragraph indices, prompts and seeds, while annotated.md guides placement. Shared seeds and preambles control inputs but do not by themselves guarantee a uniform visual style across model outputs.

alt.zh: placement_map 记录每张图的段落索引、prompt 和 seed，annotated.md 给作者定位提示。共享 seed 与前缀是一种控制输入的方式，不能单独保证不同模型输出同一视觉风格。
alt.en: placement_map records paragraph indices, prompts and seeds, while annotated.md guides placement. Shared seeds and preambles control inputs but do not by themselves guarantee a uniform visual style across model outputs.

body.zh: 有 key 的非 dry-run 可能调用远程后端；本示例只跑强制 mock 的计划。
body.en: A keyed non-dry-run can call remote backends. This example runs forced-mock planning only.

note.zh: 实际运行文章配图和封面 dry-run。示例文章分为 13 段，最多 3 个配图点，另生成一条封面计划。没有生成真实插图，也没有验证模型审美或跨图一致性。
note.en: The actual article and cover dry-runs split the sample into thirteen segments, choose up to three illustration spots and create one cover plan. They do not render real illustrations or validate model aesthetics or consistency.

body.zh: 13 段文章输出 3 个 mock 配图点。
body.en: The thirteen-segment article yields three mock spots.

body.zh: 从标题得到单张封面描述，尚未渲染。
body.en: Create a single title-derived cover brief without rendering.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+。--dry-run 强制 mock；示例也显式设置 DUANHUI_MOCK=1，避免调用已配置的后端。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+. --dry-run forces mock behavior; the examples also set DUANHUI_MOCK=1 to avoid configured backend calls.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/duanhui.git
cd duanhui
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

DUANHUI_MOCK=1 python -m duanhui.cli run examples/sample_article.md --dry-run -n 3
DUANHUI_MOCK=1 python -m duanhui.cli run examples/sample_article.md --cover --dry-run

limitations.zh: mock 计划和占位图不代表真实模型的语义或图像质量。
limitations.en: Mock plans and placeholders do not establish real-model semantic or image quality.

limitations.zh: 共享风格提示不保证每张生成图完全一致。
limitations.en: Shared style prompts do not guarantee identical visual consistency across generated images.

limitations.zh: 本次未验证远程 API、图片渲染和平台发布。
limitations.en: Remote APIs, image rendering and platform publishing were not exercised in this demo.
